title: Statistical analysis of age-related anatomical-site prognosis in cholangiocarcinoma
description: Analysis code and non-identifiable aggregate results for age-specific cancer-death, other-death, and all-cause risk comparisons in cholangiocarcinoma. Includes standardized risk estimation, case-definition comparisons, descriptive subtype decomposition, patient-cluster bootstrap, and numerical diagnostics. No patient records, fitted patient-level model objects, or manuscript files are included.
